# RelaySwarmKit

> Swift library for RelaySwarm rendezvous over Nostr, including encrypted WebRTC session descriptions.

## Documentation

- [Swift integration](https://github.com/forgesworn/relayswarm-kit/blob/main/README.md): Package setup, signalling and example code.
- [Core integration](https://github.com/forgesworn/relayswarm-kit/blob/main/docs/core-integration.md): Shared RelaySwarm interfaces and platform boundaries.

## ForgeSworn ecosystem

- [ForgeSworn library guide](https://forgesworn.dev/llms.txt): Find related libraries, tools and integration guides by task and runtime.
- [ForgeSworn on GitHub](https://github.com/forgesworn): Browse the organisation’s public repositories.
- [Project source](https://github.com/forgesworn/relayswarm-kit): Canonical source repository, documentation and release information.
- [relayswarm](https://github.com/forgesworn/relayswarm): Peer-assisted HLS library, shared protocol and browser integration.
